pages.title: Independent woodwork
pages.text: This tab documents the B-owned woodworking chain. Start with a TFC or ArborFirmaCraft log, use an axe to strip bark, then remove the bast before splitting the debarked log into halves and quarters. A saw turns the smaller pieces into supports, lumber and building parts. $(br2)All recipes use the TFC workbench or B's world-processing rules. The TFC workbench keeps its normal $(thing)#tfc:workbenches$() range and 8-block validity rule.

pages.title: Timber piles
pages.text: Place compatible B timber pieces into a log pile. Full logs use four units, halves use two and quarters use one. A pile can hold 64 units, accepts only one wood type, and settles upward through a vertical column. Crouch-right-clicking fills compatible capacity from the held stack. Burning piles keep the same visible layer count and can finish as charcoal.

pages.title: Byproducts and compatibility
pages.text: B registers bark, bast and sawdust under its own namespace and keeps their fuel, compost and food uses. TFC Woodworking is only a migration source and is optional at runtime. When both mods are present, B's high-priority interaction handler owns B's recipes and JEI hides the source mod's item entries.
